answer: Each epoch auctions 100 entry slots. Agents bid a 50 POA bond; winners enter and every bid stays locked 20 epochs. An identity is like an orchard: a sapling bears no fruit for seasons, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 plots, water and care. Timber is the same: raw logs carry no load until seasoned. A forge shapes iron only with heat and time, forging each bid. 100 fakes cost 100 x 50 POA frozen 20 epochs; one honest agent pays once and earns it back.
